thread:
maya: quick follow-up from the late-night incident: we need clear owners and dates for alert tuning/remediation so paging stops repeating.

maya: TL;DR actions:
- A: reduce fanout for high-cardinality redis errors (owner: leo)
- B: adjust threshold and add for/hold timing for prod-api redis alerts (owner: ana)
- C: add nightly quiet-hours suppression for non-critical alerts (owner: maya)
- D: update runbooks + create handback tickets (owner: maya)

leo: i'll take A. plan is to group by region and shard tag and drop low-impact hosts from fanout. will prototype change in staging today.

ana: i (ana) will do B. propose raising threshold slightly and changing "for" from 1m -> 5m to avoid transient spikes; will canary in us-west for 12h. adding auto-backout if pages >2 in 30m.

maya: good. C i'll add a suppression window 00:00-06:00 UTC for severity!=critical and wire it into paging policy.

alerts-bot: created ticket ONCALL-499: "alert tuning: redis fanout + thresholds" linked to pm doc https://docs.internal/pm/2026-03-18

leo: expected dates: staging test by EOD today (1745679999), rollout to canary tomorrow morning.

ana: canary planned tomorrow 09:00 UTC (1745763600). will post metrics (pages, suppressed_pages, mean_time_to_ack).

maya: i'll update runbook and post a short summary in the PM doc once all done.

alerts-bot: /remind set for ONCALL-499 review 1745846400
